Nia (CS): Quick round TalonBio wants a 90m "Migration + Runbook Lab" next Wed. Need to lock time and facilitators. Who's available? :calendar:
Ben - Enablement: I can lead. Prefer morning slot for EMEA attendees. We'll need 2 facilitators and 1 infra floater.
Eli_CSM: They expect ~7 engineers across two squads. Also noted a possible procurement pause next quarter please capture renewal signals.
Chris_Support: I can be infra floater. Need a list of required scopes (service account vs short-lived key). I'll prep a provisioning script.
Nia (CS): Proposed slots: Wed 08:3010:00 PT or Wed 11:0012:30 PT. Ben which do you prefer?
Ben - Enablement: 08:30 PT works for me. That gives EMEA overlap.
Eli_CSM: 08:30 PT okay for customer too. I'll confirm attendees and procurement status in a 15m pre-call tomorrow.
Chris_Support: I'll create a disposable org and a sandbox. Sample key command (internal):
```
# create short-lived key for lab
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/keys -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"purpose":"lab","ttl":"4h"}'
```
Ben - Enablement: Draft agenda: 1) 10m intro + success criteria, 2) 25m migration demo, 3) 35m guided lab (two 15min checkpoints), 4) 10m QA, 5) 10m next steps & renewal signals. I'll attach a 1p pre-read with acceptance checks.
Nia (CS): Calendar? EventBot please create and send invites when Eli confirms attendees. Also tag Sales if procurement risk shows up.
EventBot: Event queued: TalonBio Migration + Runbook Lab  Wed 08:30 PT. Calendar invites will be sent once attendees confirmed. :white_check_mark:
Eli_CSM: I'll confirm attendees by EOD and post any procurement flags here. If procurement slips, propose a short follow-up 30m POA session focused on ROI to keep momentum.
